goal: Is ke baad aap 2-D array declare kar sakein ge, usay nested braces se bhar sakein ge, nested loops se parh aur print kar sakein ge, aur row sum aur column sum nikaal sakein ge.
warmup: Apni class ke bahar lagi result sheet ko dekho. Har row ek student hai aur har column ek subject. Ali ke Maths ke marks dhoondne ke liye aap Ali ki ROW par jate hain aur phir Maths ke COLUMN par. Cinema ki ticket bhi aise hi kaam karti hai: Row 3, Seat 5. One-dimensional array boxes ki sirf ek line hoti hai. Two-dimensional array boxes ka poora table hota hai, aur ek box dhoondne ke liye aap ko DO numbers chahiye.
definition: 2-D array values ko rows aur columns mein store karta hai, bilkul table ya matrix ki tarah. Isay do sizes ke saath declare kiya jata hai: type name[ROWS][COLUMNS]. int m[3][4] mein 3 rows aur 4 columns hain, is liye us mein 3 x 4 = 12 values aati hain. Kisi element tak do indexes se pohanchte hain, m[row][column], aur dono indexes 0 se shuru hote hain. Is liye pehla element m[0][0] hai aur int m[3][4] mein aakhri element m[2][3] hai.
howItWorks: Table ko socho jis mein side par row aur upar column hota hai. m[1][2] ka matlab hai: row 1 par jao, phir column 2 par. Har element par jane ke liye hum do loops use karte hain, ek doosre ke andar. OUTER loop ek row (i) chunta hai. Us row ke liye INNER loop saare columns (j) par chalta hai. Inner loop khatam hone ke baad hum nayi line print karte hain aur outer loop agli row par chala jata hai. Input aur output isi tarah hote hain. Row sum: i ko fix rakhein aur j ko badalne dein. Column sum: j ko fix rakhein aur i ko badalne dein, is liye outer loop column ka hota hai. Computer ki memory ke andar table nahi hota, balkay ek lambi line hoti hai. C++ table ko row by row store karta hai (row-major order): pehle row 0 ki saari values, phir row 1 ki, aur isi tarah aage. Isi liye cin se table bharte waqt sab se pehle pehli row bharti hai.
